Topic 5.4: Virtues: honesty
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Virtues: honesty, part of Akhlaq 5.3 Virtues: manners of walking Road safety use (3 lessons) By the end of in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: How can one uphold honesty in the society? 2. Why should one uphold honesty?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Virtues: honesty together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital Literacy: the skills of interacting with digital technology and connecting with technology enhanced as learners search

online on the Islamic teachings on honesty and make notes

● Communication and Collaboration: the skills of listening, speaking, writing and teamwork enhanced as learners buzz on the

significance of upholding honesty in groups and present on charts as well as writing a short essay on personal encounters on

honesty and present in class

● Learning to learn: the skill of carrying out research enhanced as learners research on ways in which honesty is manifested

(home, work, school, business) and make class presentation

● Creativity and imagination: the skill of networking enhanced as learners role play acts depicting honesty, record and share

online

Values:
● Responsibility enhanced as learners buzz on the significance of upholding honesty in groups and present on charts

● Respect enhanced as learners respect each other’s opinion during group discussions

● Integrity enhanced as learners dramatise acts depicting honesty

● Unity enhanced as learners buzz on the significance of upholding honesty in groups, make charts and display in class

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Life skills: self-esteem enhanced as learners dramatise acts depicting honesty
